segments.subtask: The robot is positioned near the counter with a silver cup visible on the left side of the counter.
The robot arm moves toward the silver cup and begins to grasp it.
The robot successfully grasps the silver cup and lifts it from the counter.
The robot moves the silver cup from the left side of the counter toward the right side.
The robot places the silver cup on the right side of the counter.
The robot releases the silver cup and begins to retract its arm.
